title: Tower of God: The First Test
alt: A wall of tall black iron bars with spear points and a row of rings crosses the whole picture. Behind it a great space is full of flowing green light, brightest low in the middle. A huge white eel with red patches, a long black head and thin red fins bends across that space, and a black ball hangs under it. In front of the bars is a dark stone floor with long stripes of green light and of shadow that come toward us. A boy stands on it with his back to us, small and dark, with a thin black needle in his hand.
summary: A painting of the first test from Tower of God in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is the first test of Tower of God, the webtoon by SIU. A boy, Bam, comes into the Tower to look for his friend Rachel. On the first floor he must break a ball. The ball hangs in a space that is full of shinsu, behind a wall of bars, and the White Steel Eel lives there.
He has the Black March, a needle that a princess of the Tower lends him. We see him from far back, small, with his back to us. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
